docs.title: About
docs.text:
I build domain-specific AI systems for engineering workflows — from RAG assistants that retrieve internal knowledge with citations to robust vision models for adverse weather perception.

Focus areas - Agentic/Light RAG for enterprise assistants (accuracy · latency · cost) - Automotive Model-Based Development tooling (ASCET/MLSL) & CI/testing automation - Vision State Space Models (SSM) for deraining/restoration
